name: MyInvs
oneLine: A portfolio tracker with an LLM analysis agent for risk and market context.
problem: Tracking investments and understanding their risk and tax position takes manual work across several sources.
built: A Python application with a LangGraph analysis agent whose steps cover portfolio data, market context, news sentiment, risk calculation and synthesis. Any dashboard shown on this site uses synthetic data only.
decisions: The agent is split into one node per concern, so each step can be tested on its own.
